summary: Equinor ASA furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing weekly transactions under the third tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme, announced 22 July 2026 and running 23 July to no later than 26 October 2026. From 7-11 September 2026 the company repurchased 683,570 own shares at a weighted average of NOK 406.9977 on OSE, CEUX and TQEX. Accumulated tranche buy-backs reached 5,032,090 shares at NOK 390.6069, totaling NOK 1.966bn; treasury now 19,484,487 shares, or 0.81% of capital.
